title: Profile sensitivity sweep and deployment gates for low-bit quant kernels
creator: Maya Patel
description:
Objective: Build a reproducible eval harness and gating rules that quantify per-profile and per-layer quality regressions for int8/int4 AWQ and GPTQ variants, and automate threshold decisions for canary, gradual rollout, and rollback.

Background: We've seen intermittent quality regressions after downstream deployments of AWQ and GPTQ profiles on customer traffic. Existing post-deploy alerts are noisy and slow to act because we lack: (1) a sensitivity map by layer/profile, (2) prompt-stratified baselines, and (3) automatic gating logic tied into CI/CD and the console. This ticket implements a structured approach to quantify impact and close the loop with deploy controls.

Plan: 1) Assemble a stratified prompt-set (slices: instruction-following, summarization, code, safety-edge cases) with golden references and lightweight automated metrics (L1/ROUGE/QA pass rate/embedding-distance + our human-calibrated acceptability score). 2) Implement per-profile "sensitivity sweep": progressively apply quant config changes (per-layer bit reductions, group size, AWQ/GPTQ algorithm variant) to capture delta metrics and per-layer sensitivity rank. 3) Add synthetic perturbation tests (temperature shifts, long-context KV stress) to expose edge regressions that don't show up in small benches. 4) Define numeric thresholds for automated gating (canary fail, slow-roll stop, full rollback) per profile and per workload slice. 5) Integrate into CI/CD: new presubmit check for major profile changes, and a canary job that runs the sweep on real traffic samples prior to full rollout. 6) Dashboard: surface sensitivity heatmaps and suggested rollback points in Console (per-model, per-profile).

Deliverables: - Eval harness code and Jupyter notebook for sensitivity sweeps. - Sensitivity matrix CSV for supported models and profiles. - Canary job config and CD pipeline gating rules. - Console dashboard mockup and a PRD for rollout automation.

Non-goals: This ticket does not implement per-customer RBAC for rollouts or on-prem deployment integration; those are follow-ups.
acceptance_criteria: Stratified prompt-set (>=500 items) checked in to eval repo with metadata tags
Sensitivity sweep runs produce reproducible CSVs and per-layer rank for at least two models (one Llama-derivative, one MPT) across AWQ and GPTQ profiles
Gating thresholds defined and documented (numeric fail/pass cutoffs) per workload slice
Presubmit job hooks added: a lightweight quant-profile smoke test and a heavier canary job for staged deployments
Console dashboard mock and backend flag created to surface sensitivity heatmap and last Canary run report
